# GEO report: quay-store **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 40/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 12 ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. High = (12 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. Cap applied: GEO-009 is a blocker (a search crawler blocked site-wide), so the score cannot exceed 40. This is a read-from-code score. Three things hold it back. `robots.txt` shuts Googlebot out of the whole site. Pages are rendered only in the browser. The page metadata has gaps. All three are cheap to fix. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking Googlebot - **Why it matters:** Googlebot is told to crawl nothing, so Google can't read any page. The same rule also leaves every important route unindexable, so it costs GEO-009 and GEO-014 (6 points). - **Where:** `static/robots.txt:4-5` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: Googlebot` / `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small (delete the 3-line group) - **Score after this:** 18 ÷ 25 = **72**, because the cap of 40 lifts. ### 2. Render pages on the server - **Why it matters:** With `ssr = false`, the HTML sent to crawlers is an empty shell. The headings, text and nav links only appear after JavaScript runs, and many crawlers don't run it. This costs GEO-003 (3 points). - **Where:** `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` - **What the code says:** `export const ssr = false;` - **Size:** Small to Medium. Remove the line, or prerender the pages with `adapter-static` and `export const prerender = true`. - **Score after this:** done alone, 15 ÷ 25 = 60 but still capped at **40**. Done together with item 1, 21 ÷ 25 = **84**. ### 3. Add `lang` and fill the missing descriptions - **Why it matters:** Crawlers can't tell the page language. `/shop` has an empty description, and `/search` has none. This costs GEO-012 (2 points). - **Where:** `src/app.html:2`, `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` - **What the code says:** `` and `` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** adds 2 points on top of items 1 and 2, so the three together give 23 ÷ 25 = **92**. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt valid and reachable | Clear | `static/robots.txt`, valid lines, tiny | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have access | Problem | `static/robots.txt:4-5` (Googlebot blocked, assumed goal is to be found) | | GEO-014 | Routes are indexable | Problem | `/` and `/shop` are blocked for Googlebot by `robots.txt:5` (`/search` is deliberately noindex) | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on own origin | Clear | `/` and `/shop` use `https://quay.example/...`, matching the sitemap | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Problem | `src/routes/+layout.ts:1`, site-wide | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD valid and complete | Problem | `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`, Product has only `name` | | GEO-011 | Sitemap discoverable | Clear | `static/sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt:7` | | GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Problem | `src/app.html:2` has no lang; `/shop` description empty; `/search` has no description | | GEO-016 | Server-rendered links | Clear | `src/routes/+layout.svelte:5` has `` links (see GEO-003 for rendering) | | GEO-017 | Snippet limits vs AI search | Clear | only an element-level `data-nosnippet` (`+layout.svelte:7`) | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Clear | read the layout and all 3 pages: no images, links have text, titles present | | GEO-101 | App association files | Not applicable | no app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (info only) | Not applicable | none present, not scored | | GEO-102 | App structured data (info only) | Not applicable | none present, not scored | ## Other problems found - `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`: `"@type":"Product","name":"Bilge pump"`. The page lists several products, but the data describes one product and has no `offers`, `review` or `aggregateRating`. Either add `offers` (price and currency) or remove it. This is scored under GEO-004. ## Worth considering - **`/search` has no ``:** `src/routes/search/+page.svelte:2` has `Search`. The page is deliberately noindex, so a description is optional. - **The shop page names products but doesn't list them:** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:9` has `Bilge pumps, cleats and rope.` Give each product its own page and address, linked from `/shop` and added to the sitemap. That might help readers and machines. - **Say what the free-delivery claim covers:** `src/routes/+layout.svelte:7` has `
Free delivery over £50.
`. The home page claims "shipped next day" (`+page.svelte:3`), but no page explains delivery terms, regions or returns. A delivery page would answer what visitors will ask. - **Add a sitemap ``:** `static/sitemap.xml:3` has `https://quay.example/`. Add real dates if you have them. - **Describe the site's identity:** nothing in the repo states the store's name or links in structured data. Organization or WebSite JSON-LD in `+layout.svelte` could carry what the pages already show. - **Improve the titles and the main page structure:** `src/routes/+page.svelte:2` has `Quay: boat parts`. `/shop` is titled just `Shop all parts`. Add the brand name to it. `src/app.html:8` wraps everything in a bare `
`, so use `
` for the page content. - **Add `viewport`:** `src/app.html:4` has `` but no viewport tag. - **The nav leaves out `/search`:** `src/routes/+layout.svelte:5` has `
Home Shop
`. This is fine if you want search kept out of reach. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live status codes and headers:** `X-Robots-Tag` headers and real 200 responses for the sitemap URLs can only be confirmed with a live check. - **Training crawlers:** `GPTBot` and `ClaudeBot` aren't blocked in `robots.txt`. This isn't scored, so tell me if you want them blocked. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site, because there's no `geo.config.json` to say otherwise. - `https://quay.example` is the real site origin, since `robots.txt`, the sitemap and the canonicals all use it. - `/search` is deliberately noindex, and it isn't in the sitemap. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-009`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
